'''Djinn Altis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Djinn headed the [[Altisian Jedi]] sect, a split faction of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who did not follow the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] but continued to serve the Republic.

==Biography==
===Early life===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Djinn Altis was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at an early age and [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Djinn Altis began to develop a philosophy that differed from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] interpretation of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. Believing that individuals of any age could be trained in the ways of the Force, Altis also had disdain for the rule regarding the amount of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] a Jedi could take. Most radical of all was his belief in the institution of marriage, believing that attachments should be encouraged among Jedi as long as they were kept in check. Despite his somewhat radical beliefs, Altis ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], and at some point discovered a young [[Callista Ming|Callista Masana]] on the world of [[Chad/Legends|Chadra]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

As a Master, Altis opened a [[Praxeum ship/Legends|mobile academy]] called the [[Chu'unthor (Clone Wars)|''Chu'unthor'']] sometime around [[35 BBY]], aboard which he taught his beliefs to all those who would listen. Believed by some to be a wise [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] and by many more to be a crazed old heretic, Altis gathered a following of pupils who came to be known collectively as the [[Altisian Jedi]] by the Coruscant-trained members of the Order. There, he educated his students in not only the techniques taught to mainstream Jedi, but also powers thought of as arcane or heretical; such as the ability [[Essence transfer|to preserve one's consciousness after death]] by transferring it to an inanimate object. Hiding the ship in the clouds of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], Altis married a local Bespin woman named [[Margani Altis|Margani]], encouraging his acolytes to do the same.<ref name="CWNP" />

===The Clone Wars===
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Altis and his followers granted aid to the Republic and the Order which cast them out. Among the Jedi who fought alongside the Republic were Masana, [[Geith Eris]], [[Ash Jarvee]], and Altis himself. Altis, who believed the Force had called upon him and his students to help defend the Republic, had a shaky relationship with the Council during the war, agreeing to help as long as they were not forced to give up their beliefs. Setting out aboard the ''[[Wookiee Gunner]]'', the Altisian Jedi sought to bring humanitarian aid across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During one such mission to [[Yarille]], Altis and his compatriots were summoned by the Force to aid a young [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Hallena Devis]] who was stranded on [[JanFathal]]. Combining forces with a Padawan named [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], Altis and Tano were able to extract Devis with as little bloodshed as possible, though to Altis's horror, he found that the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] often demonstrated a ruthless nature. During this time, Altis also met with Tano's master, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], offering refuge should the High Council ever expel him for his secret marriage to the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="CWNP" />

Following the conflict on JanFathal, Altis and his people returned to their original mission to Yarille and were horrified by the destruction wrought there in their absence. Rejecting the war, Altis and his people set out to end it as soon as possible.

===The Dark Times===
When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Republic issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], declaring all Jedi to be traitors to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Jedi Order was [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|effectively destroyed]] and the Altisians went underground. Because they did not often work side-by-side with the Grand Army and its [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], most Altisians survived the initial attacks and were able to rendezvous on Bespin. Altis remained in contact with several surviving Jedi, including Masters [[Plett]] and [[Iri Camas]].<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> In time, he was contacted by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], who despite their age-old feud with the Jedi Order had taken in several survivors on their [[Mandalore/Legends|homeworld]]. Altis dealt with a man named [[Kal Skirata]], and was able to bring [[Kina Ha]] and [[Arligan Zey]] back to the Chu'unthor, though a young Jedi named [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Scout]] decided that she'd rather stay with the Mandalorians.

===Legacy===
Though Altis would not live to see it, his student Callista Masana would go on to use his training to preserve her consciousness for decades, and ultimately meet the founding members of the [[New Jedi Order]].

==Behind the scenes==
The reference to Altis's death on Dathomir is based on a somewhat confusing passage in [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']] where Luke refers to the original ''Chu'unthor'' as though it was Altis's ship. His "maverick" behavior is largely a [[retroactive continuity]] fix to explain why Callista's [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] differed from the norms established in the [[prequel trilogy]].
